messages:
maria: Quick pulse — final version alignment for tomorrow's cut. Cutoff is 10:00am PT. Are API/runtime/console/SDK changelogs ready and CI green? I'll start tagging once we have green across the board. @sam @li

sam: API changelog done, PR https://github.com/redwood/inference-api/pull/412 merged. CI passed last run. docs/CHANGELOG.md updated. Will bump to v0.14.3 in release branch now.

li: Runtime side: PR https://github.com/redwood/inference-runtime/pull/987 ready but stuck on integration tests (perf regression flake). Investigating, ETA ~2h. Keeping on canary until fixed. :thinking_face:

aman: Console: I can cut console v1.9.0 after API tag. I have a small fix for the changelog formatting, pushed to branch. Need API client compat check.

maria: @li that's okay if runtime is canary. We need a fallback plan — if runtime doesn't land by cutoff, we switch runtime to v0.14.2-stable and proceed. Agree?

li: Agree. If tests fail we won't block API/console. I'll post status by 8:30am PT.

release-bot: [release-bot] nightly-ci/runtime-integration — failed 1 job: perf-regression-suite. Link: https://ci.example.com/teams/runtime/987/failures

sam: @maria tagging prefs: API minor bump + patch for docs, no schema changes. SDKs: @jen can you run client compatibility tests once API is tagged?

jen: Yup. I'll run against staging endpoint. ETA 30m after tag. Please add me to PR reviewers.

carla: Heads-up: changelog upload for enterprise-changelog bucket requires the new version key format. I'll handle after tag. Need the exact version string.

maria: Ok plan: sam tags API v0.14.3 by 8:15, jen runs SDK tests 8:20–8:40, aman cuts console v1.9.0 8:45, li updates if runtime passes, else fallback to v0.14.2. I'll start release notes draft now. Callout: update rollout policy in console to include traffic cutoff.

sam: Tagging now: `git tag -a v0.14.3 -m "release: API v0.14.3" && git push origin v0.14.3` — PR link for tag: https://github.com/redwood/inference-api/pull/420 :rocket:

jen: Tests started, running e2e client matrix. Will report back.

li: Quick update: narrowed down perf flake — reproduces with sequence-length=4096 on A100 driver X. Filing bug, will try a hotfix. If no green by 9:30, fallback.

jen: e2e matrix green for 3/4 clients, one flaky Node client failing auth header formatting. Fix incoming, should be <15m.

maria: Thanks — keeping this thread as single source. I'll ping again at 9am PT for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
